question_text: How many distinct object_id values were tracked at Gate_MainEntrance across all entry/exit events on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?
answer_text: There were 2951 distinct object_id values at camera_location Gate_MainEntrance across all entry/exit events on 2025-12-08 (UTC).

citations.cypher:
MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera {camera_location: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
WHERE e.event_type IN ['person_entry','person_exit','car_entry','car_exit']
  AND e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
RETURN count(DISTINCT e.object_id) AS distinct_object_ids
